import csv
import sqlite3

with open("customers.csv", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    csv_rows = [(int(r["id"]), r["name"], r["email"], r["city"]) for r in csv.DictReader(f)]

conn = sqlite3.connect("customers.db")
db_rows = sorted(conn.execute("SELECT id, name, email, city FROM customers"))
conn.close()

print("CSV rows:", len(csv_rows), "| DB rows:", len(db_rows))
print("Match:", sorted(csv_rows) == db_rows)
for r in db_rows:
    print(r)
